maya: hitting "Cannot use import statement outside a module" when importing our SDK in a Vercel Edge fn. works in node.

maya: repro: `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-sdk'` in Next edge route.

tony: likely resolver choosing CJS fallback. what's our exports map?

maya: currently . -> { require: ./dist/cjs/index.js, import: ./dist/esm/index.mjs } and types -> dist/index.d.ts only.

sarah: two quick things: add an "edge" conditional that points to a small ESM edge build, and add an "exports" condition for "types" so TS resolves correctly.

ryan: also split env logic (auth/retries) into adapters. node adapter can keep undici and retries; edge adapter uses native fetch so bundles stay tiny.

maya: pragmatic short-term: I'll add an edge-target ESM build + exports.edge -> ./dist/edge/index.mjs and types export. will also add examples/next-edge smoke sample.

tony: conservative follow-up: run internal monorepo tests for require-only consumers.

devex-bot: reminder: update migration docs and add CI job to bundle the example with esbuild/Next edge target.

maya: opening PR now, will tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
